Embedded Document Download [114.50 KB] ## There are some things you should state clearly state in the contract, including: Image Modifications: Anything regarding changes, furnishing, maintenance should be announced upfront because most landlords do not agree to any alterations to the property. Once done without approval, this can cost your deposit or even more.   Payment: Payment of monthly/quarterly rent should be manifest in terms of payment method and due date.   Pets: Most landlords would require tenants to place a pet fee or pet deposit in chance any damage is caused.   Subletting: Subletting is quite uncommon in the market of Hanoi housing.
